metadata.audit_title: LearnSense Real-World JEE Educational PDF Benchmark Integrity and Recall Audit
metadata.cross_domain_experiment: NEET Biology (Cell Cycle and Cell Division)

finding_1_relaxed_precision_distortion.issue: Reported precision (99.75%) used a relaxed noise-rejection metric rather than true precision against gold standards.
finding_1_relaxed_precision_distortion.formula_used_in_benchmark: valid_concept_count = sum(1 for c in concepts if is_gold or (c.name not in gold_noise and len(c.name) >= 3))
finding_1_relaxed_precision_distortion.impact: Masked non-academic phrase extractions and measured noise rejection rather than precision against curriculum targets.

finding_2_asymmetric_substring_matching.issue: Evaluation metric used asymmetric substring matching ('norm_ext in norm_gold') without 1-to-1 bipartite constraints.
finding_2_asymmetric_substring_matching.impact: Single generic candidate words (e.g., 'Friction', 'Matrix') matched up to 8-14 separate specific gold concepts, artificially inflating reported recall.

finding_3_gold_standard_syllabus_drift.issue: Gold annotations were constructed from broad JEE syllabus outlines rather than verbatim content of the short revision notes PDFs.
finding_3_gold_standard_syllabus_drift.impact: 16 out of 38 apparent false negatives (42.1%) literally do not exist in the source documents. True reachable text-present recall is 92.51% (PCM) vs reported 78.56%.

finding_4_evidence_grounding_integrity.issue: Audited provenance coordinates and character excerpts for all 974 concepts across all 11 documents.
finding_4_evidence_grounding_integrity.semantic_support: 100.0% (974/974) verbatim text containment at designated span coordinates

finding_5_held_out_leakage_and_domain_se.issue: Single-word additions ('permutation', 'combination', 'factorial') after observing held-out failures created evaluation leakage.
finding_5_held_out_leakage_and_domain_se.resolution: Isolated held-out partition and separated Biology cross-domain from primary JEE Main Paper 1 aggregate.

prioritized_improvement_plan.title: Enumeration Prefix Trimming
prioritized_improvement_plan.description: Strip leading list markers, numbering, and outline indicators: ^(?:[0-9]+[\.\)]|\([0-9ivxabc]+\)|[a-z][\.\)])\s*
prioritized_improvement_plan.expected_gain: Fixes 3 false negatives (G1 Phase, G2 Phase, Division into Groups) and cleans dirty headers.

prioritized_improvement_plan.title: Extended Function Words & Preposition Trimming
prioritized_improvement_plan.description: Add missing prepositions (around, between, among, under, above, through, onto, towards, within, without) to eliminate prepositional prefix leaks.
prioritized_improvement_plan.expected_gain: Removes non-academic candidate noise and improves precision.

prioritized_improvement_plan.title: Common Action Verb Filtering
prioritized_improvement_plan.description: Expand verb filtering to include descriptive verbs: lose/loses, gain/gains, carry/carries, contain/contains, consist/consists, rotate/rotates, undergo/undergoes, involve/involves.
prioritized_improvement_plan.expected_gain: Eliminates verb phrase extractions ('undergoes hybridization', 'loses its energy', 'carries the entire mass').

prioritized_improvement_plan.title: Compound Concept Trailing Preposition Exception
prioritized_improvement_plan.description: Allow established academic compound terms ending in prepositions/particles (e.g., 'Crossing Over', 'Roll Over') while rejecting general trailing prepositions.
prioritized_improvement_plan.expected_gain: Recovers 'Crossing Over' in genetics and cell division without compromising prepositional rejection rules.

prioritized_improvement_plan.title: Acronym and Character Limit Normalization
prioritized_improvement_plan.description: Extract parenthesized acronyms as standalone candidates before length truncation (e.g. 'Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion (VSEPR)' -> 'VSEPR').
prioritized_improvement_plan.expected_gain: Recovers VSEPR Theory and long compound academic terms.

prioritized_improvement_plan.title: Bipartite 1-to-1 Matching in Evaluation Suite
prioritized_improvement_plan.description: Replace asymmetric substring matching with Kuhn-Munkres (Hungarian algorithm) or greedy 1-to-1 maximum bipartite matching.
prioritized_improvement_plan.expected_gain: Eliminates metric inflation where one generic token matches multiple distinct gold concepts.
